content:
I understand you think by not belonging.
I mean think in the wrong places and way.
And you don't discriminate against
backpacks I imagine or the temperature
of a floor? Or the floor at all.
Can you send me the poetry you
wrote before solving the rota conjecture?

Rx
readme: An unfinished letter to June Huh, a "mathematician at the Institute for Advanced Study and Princeton University", who thinks about geometry.
title: Not belonging
